policy: Unknown mutation outcomes must be reconciled against server state before retrying non-idempotent actions.
Financial mutations must never be blindly repeated after timeout.
Trip GPS must remain active until authoritative backend completion is confirmed.
Client state is not authoritative for permissions, eligibility, booking/payment status, delivery ACK or privileged configuration.
Physical UI and acceptance tests remain deferred until all four packages are implemented.

journeys.name: Customer/Driver/Admin authentication and OTP
journeys.success: Backend verifies actor, OTP and exact purpose; establish only the authorized session and continue to required profile/onboarding state.
journeys.denial: Keep session unauthenticated; show purpose-safe denial and remaining attempts without leaking secrets.
journeys.timeout: Keep OTP expiry and request state explicit; do not treat timeout as successful verification.
journeys.reconnect: Refresh server-owned OTP/session status before allowing another protected action.
journeys.cancellation: User may leave the flow; do not create a session without server verification.
journeys.retry: Respect resend interval, request idempotency and attempt carry-forward rules; new OTP replaces the prior OTP.
journeys.unknownOutcome: Reconcile request/session status with backend before re-submitting or navigating into authenticated screens.
journeys.duplicateProtection: OTP verification and session creation must not be treated as client-only success.

journeys.name: Passenger booking, quote, fare and matching
journeys.success: Display only server-authoritative quote, eligibility and booking/matching state.
journeys.denial: Show the backend reason and preserve safe draft fields; never imply booking exists.
journeys.timeout: Show pending/unknown and query booking by authoritative identifier before retry.
journeys.reconnect: Refresh quote validity, service enablement, eligibility and booking state before resuming.
journeys.cancellation: Cancellation is a backend state transition with reason and resulting state; do not only remove the local card.
journeys.retry: Use the same idempotency key for retry of the same logical create; prevent duplicate bookings.
journeys.unknownOutcome: Do not submit a second create; reconcile by request/idempotency/booking ID and refresh authoritative state.
journeys.duplicateProtection: No duplicate booking or matching action after timeout/reconnect.

journeys.name: Payment, wallet, fare adjustment and refund
journeys.success: Show completed financial state only after backend/provider confirmation.
journeys.denial: Keep prior authoritative balance/receipt; present a safe reason without exposing payment secrets.
journeys.timeout: Mark outcome pending/unknown and reconcile provider/backend transaction status.
journeys.reconnect: Refresh transaction and wallet ledger before presenting final status.
journeys.cancellation: Explain whether cancellation happened before or after financial commitment; refund is a distinct state/action.
journeys.retry: Retry only through idempotent transaction contract; never blindly repeat charge/refund.
journeys.unknownOutcome: Query transaction reference/status and ledger; do not infer failure from client timeout.
journeys.duplicateProtection: Financial mutations must be idempotent and backend-ledger authoritative.

journeys.name: Event discovery/session booking and trip
journeys.success: Use EVENT service and EVENT_RIDE for eligibility/availability while preserving the approved persisted RIDE/CITY_RIDE plus EVENT_RIDE subtype mapping.
journeys.denial: Show unavailable/disabled event service or capacity/eligibility denial from backend.
journeys.timeout: Reconcile event session and booking status before retrying.
journeys.reconnect: Refresh published event, stop/session and booking state from server; do not invent missing stops.
journeys.cancellation: Use backend cancellation policy and preserve the event booking state transition.
journeys.retry: Idempotently retry the same event booking request only after reconciliation.
journeys.unknownOutcome: Fetch session/booking status by server identifier before any new booking request.
journeys.duplicateProtection: EVENT toggle is independently enforced even where persisted booking type is RIDE.

journeys.name: Driver registration, KYC, vehicle and geographic eligibility
journeys.success: Submission accepted only when required profile/KYC/vehicle data and active valid city/state assignment satisfy backend rules.
journeys.denial: Preserve draft, identify actionable missing/rejected items and keep driver unavailable until eligible.
journeys.timeout: Check application submission status before submitting again.
journeys.reconnect: Refresh application review, KYC and service assignment from backend.
journeys.cancellation: Leaving a draft does not imply submission or approval.
journeys.retry: Use safe idempotent upload/submit semantics; do not duplicate documents or applications.
journeys.unknownOutcome: Reconcile application ID and document status before resubmission.
journeys.duplicateProtection: No driver readiness/dispatch until authoritative onboarding and geographic eligibility permit it.

journeys.name: Driver trip lifecycle, GPS and completion
journeys.success: Render server-authoritative trip transitions; stop trip GPS only after completion is confirmed by authoritative backend state.
journeys.denial: Keep prior trip state and show action denial; do not advance lifecycle locally.
journeys.timeout: Retain active tracking while trip completion remains unconfirmed; reconcile before retry.
journeys.reconnect: Fetch current trip state and location freshness before enabling next transition.
journeys.cancellation: Cancellation follows allowed backend transition; active-trip GPS is not stopped merely because a request timed out.
journeys.retry: Retry a lifecycle command idempotently and refresh server state.
journeys.unknownOutcome: Treat start/finish as unknown until backend confirms; keep required GPS active and reconcile.
journeys.duplicateProtection: No duplicate start/finish/acceptance; GPS stops only after confirmed completion.

journeys.name: Admin scoped operations and privileged configuration
journeys.success: Backend authorizes role, permission and GLOBAL/STATE/CITY scope; UI refreshes authoritative changed state and audit result.
journeys.denial: Display access denied without exposing out-of-scope records or sensitive configuration.
journeys.timeout: Do not report a change as successful; query current config/object state and audit outcome.
journeys.reconnect: Re-fetch permission/session/scope and object state before enabling privileged actions.
journeys.cancellation: Confirmation dismissal causes no mutation; destructive action requires explicit confirmation and any required step-up/approval.
journeys.retry: Use idempotency or read-after-write reconciliation for bulk/config actions; avoid duplicate destructive operations.
journeys.unknownOutcome: Inspect authoritative state and audit trail before retrying configuration, role, delete or bulk mutation.
journeys.duplicateProtection: UI hiding is not authorization; server-side scope and permission checks remain mandatory.

journeys.name: Broadcaster/Gateway notification delivery and ACK
journeys.success: Show delivery success only after authenticated ACK is accepted and correlated to the durable job.
journeys.denial: Reject unauthorized gateway identity, invalid ACK or revoked device; retain truthful failure status.
journeys.timeout: Keep job pending/expired according to backend policy; do not fabricate delivered state.
journeys.reconnect: Replay from durable cursor, detect gaps and refresh server queue/status.
journeys.cancellation: Cancel only where backend job state permits; preserve audit and delivery outcome.
journeys.retry: Bounded retry with deduplication and dead-letter behavior; ACK processing is idempotent.
journeys.unknownOutcome: Query durable job/ACK state before enqueueing a duplicate job.
journeys.duplicateProtection: No duplicate delivery side effects from repeated ACKs or reconnect replay.

journeys.name: Public website downloads and Admin Web entry
journeys.success: Use backend/admin-published links and safe default icon when image assets are absent.
journeys.denial: Do not fall back to stale privileged links or local success when backend save fails.
journeys.timeout: Show save/link state as unconfirmed and re-fetch before claiming success.
journeys.reconnect: Refresh published link configuration and session/route permissions.
journeys.retry: Retry save after checking server state; avoid localStorage-only success for privileged/public configuration.
journeys.unknownOutcome: Reconcile backend-persisted link configuration before another save.
journeys.duplicateProtection: Never claim backend persistence from a local fallback.

checkpoint.next: P4-F align design tokens, responsive layouts and component states across Mobile/Web/Gateway
checkpoint.resumeRule: Continue from P4-F; do not repeat completed points unless inputs change.
